extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel land use and land cover classification dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images measuring 64x64 pixels.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.citeAs: Helber, P., Bischke, B., Dengel, A., & Borth, D. (2018). Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. In Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS), 2018 IEEE International.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images taken by the Sentinel-2A satellite associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries were downloaded via Amazon S3. Images with low cloud level were selected based on the cloud level value provided by ESA. From these images, 27,000 geo-referenced image patches measuring 64x64 pixels were extracted.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2A satellite multi-spectral image data downloaded via Amazon S3, associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were patched into 64x64 pixel windows. Bad image patches due to mislabeling, clouds, dead pixels, or ice/snow were sorted out. Bands with lower spatial resolution were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation for band evaluations. Atmospheric correction was intentionally not applied, retaining images with color cast.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Initial labels were associated based on classes described in the European Urban Atlas mapping guide. All 27,000 images were then manually checked multiple times and ground truth was corrected by sorting out mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Enables Earth observation applications including detecting land use and land cover changes (such as tracking deforestation relevant to climate change and illegal clearing), urban area development, disaster recovery, nature protection, sustainable development, and keeping crowdsourced geographical maps (e.g., OpenStreetMap) up-to-date.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution of georeferenced images is distributed across Europe and is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: A classification system trained with 64x64 image patches does not allow a finely graduated per-pixel segmentation. Images have not received atmospheric correction, resulting in some images having a color cast.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, testing, and benchmarking machine learning and deep convolutional neural networks for land use and land cover classification, land use change detection, and map updating/verification.
